title: Taking Regular Breaks at Work
paragraphs: Zain works at a desk for many hours. By the middle of the day, his head and neck often hurt. He thinks this is normal because his job is busy.
At a company health talk, he hears one simple idea. He can stand up and stretch for five minutes every hour. At first, Zain thinks he is too busy for this.
He tries short breaks for one week. In the afternoon, he feels more awake and notices fewer headaches. The change is small, but it helps him.
Now Zain sets a quiet alarm on his phone each hour. He walks to the window, fills his water bottle, or stretches his back and shoulders.
Zain tells his coworkers about the habit. It takes very little time, but it helps him feel better during his workday.
